newsitem.title: CHINA: China starts building $890 mln thermal power plant.
newsitem.headline: China starts building $890 mln thermal power plant.

text.p: China has started building a 7.4 billion yuan ($890 million) thermal power plant in the central province of Hubei, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
The first phase of the power plant in Xiangfan city would have four coal-fired generators with a capacity of 300 megawatts each, Xinhua said.
Generating capacity would later be expanded to total 6,000 megawatts to supplement the huge Three Gorges dam project on the Yangtze River, the agency said.
The Three Gorges project would have an installed capacity of 18,200 megawatts but output would be limited to just 5,000 megawatts during the low-water season of the river, it said.
